colombia.title: Trump asegura que Nicolás Maduro enfrentará nuevos cargos en su contra y dice que EE. UU. “se tomó Venezuela”
colombia.title_en: Trump says Nicolás Maduro will face new charges and claims the U.S. “took over Venezuela”

mundo.title: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
mundo.snippet: Each side is using missiles and drones to try to pound the other into giving up, breeding ceaseless human suffering. But there is no sign that either country’s determination will weaken.
mundo.title_en: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
